findings.detail: All 3 regulatory constraints covered: CON-01 by FR-001 and FR-006 (two mechanisms for the same FBO-status mitigation), CON-02 by FR-003, CON-03 by FR-004. Checked by set membership against original_input.vision_output.regulatory_posture.constraint_summaries, not assumed from the FR count.

All 3 roadmap phases addressed: Phase 1 (facilitation-only structure) by FR-001/FR-006, Phase 2 (dual-sign-off/allergen workflows) by FR-003/FR-004, Phase 3 (pilot cohort + completeness-scaled limits) by FR-007/FR-005 via the recorded compound split.
Both north-star metrics have a measurement FR: NSM-01 by FR-008, NSM-02 by FR-009.

Problem and Target Users are context sections (why/who), not independently actionable capabilities — they don't need their own dedicated FR; their substance is already reflected through the FRs addressing regulatory/roadmap/metric items. Value Proposition's buyer-discovery claim IS independently actionable and is covered by FR-002.

Every FR states an observable behaviour a tester could check directly (e.g. FR-006: 'shall never record HarvestLink as taking possession... every trade routed as direct producer/distributor-to-buyer' is testable by inspecting transaction records for a title/possession field).
No two FRs contradict; FR-001 and FR-006 both mitigate CON-01 via different mechanisms (attestation vs. routing) without overlapping claims.
